items.title: File Widerspruch against the Fahrtenbuchauflage
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielförde, Kreishaus, Förder Straße 3, 24103 Beispielförde, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 29 Sep 2026, posted by the authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG a letter posted domestically counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Sat 3 Oct 2026; for this kind of authority letter this deemed-delivery day does not shift even though it falls on a Saturday/holiday (Tag der Deutschen Einheit). Counting the one-month Widerspruchsfrist starts the next day, 3 Oct (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), and the month ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 3 Nov 2026. That day is a Tuesday, a normal working day in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift applies.

items.title: Keep a Fahrtenbuch (vehicle logbook) for six months from Bestandskraft
items.quote: Ich ordne daher an, dass Sie für dieses Fahrzeug für die Dauer von sechs Monaten ein Fahrtenbuch zu führen haben. Die Auflage beginnt mit Eintritt der Bestandskraft dieses Bescheides.
items.computation: The six-month logbook obligation does not start on a fixed calendar date but 'mit Eintritt der Bestandskraft' (once the notice becomes final/unappealable). The earliest this can occur is if no Widerspruch is filed within the one-month period computed above (ending Tue 3 Nov 2026); Bestandskraft would then enter on Wed 4 Nov 2026, the first day after the objection period expires. Counting six months from that event under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (the event day itself not counted, the period ending on the day of the sixth following month bearing the same number as the day before counting started) gives an end date of 4 May 2027. This is only the earliest plausible reading: if a Widerspruch is filed, Bestandskraft is postponed until the objection/any subsequent court proceedings are concluded, so the true start and end dates could be much later.

warnings: The logbook (Fahrtenbuch) obligation's start and end dates are estimates only: they depend on the notice reaching 'Bestandskraft', which requires no Widerspruch to be filed by 2026-11-03; if a Widerspruch is filed, the true start date is deferred and cannot be computed from this letter alone.

The letter does not state whether immediate enforcement (sofortige Vollziehung) was ordered; if it was, the logbook duty could start immediately regardless of a pending Widerspruch — check with the Kreis or a lawyer if this matters.
